prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Select a ready-to-adopt companion or create your own custom pet from scratch."]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet lives right on your desktop screen! Access settings and controls anytime from your taskbar tray icon."]
2: []
3: ["Quick Adopt Your Companion", "Confirm Companion", "Ready to adopt your selected companion instantly?"]
4: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life...", "We are generating your pet's 3D model, animations, and desktop behavior profile."]
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop pet a name! You can customize its personality and desktop behavior anytime later.", "Complete Adoption"]
6: ["Feel free to use other apps. We'll send a desktop notification when your pet is ready!"]
7: ["Signing in saves your pet data to the cloud so your companion is never lost across devices.", "Cloud Backup Enabled"]
8: ["Welcome Home!", "Your pet is officially ready and residing on your desktop."]
9: ["Pre-made pets take <1 min setup. Custom photo pets take 2-3 mins."]
